questions.q: About how long was the network of Silk Road trade routes linking China to the Mediterranean?
questions.why: The script states the routes spanned roughly 6,400 km.

questions.q: If a camel can load about 200 kg, how much can twenty camels carry?
At about 40 km a day, roughly how long would a 6,000 km journey take?
questions.why: The script gives 6,000 km ÷ 40 km/day = 150 days.
